name: Propose a know-how page
description: Proposes a know-how page from this conversation: a short title and a body in plain words, on how something is done in this organisation (a process, a policy in practice, where to find something). It is written as a knowledge-base NOTE for an Owner or Administrator to approve; it is not a page, and nothing is published until a person compiles and publishes a page from it. The text must hold no figure: no amount of money, percentage, decimal, number of a thousand or more, ID, identity number or account number, because figures are read from the tools when they are asked for and an answer carries one person's context. A proposal with a figure is refused.

key.description: The page's key, lower case with hyphens, such as how-we-file-expense-claims; Fyniq adds the prefix proposed.

title.description: The page's title, in plain words.

body.description: The know-how, in plain words and short sections, with no figure; say where a figure is read instead.
